title: Settings
subtitle: Choose how BizCost works for this business.
noSections: The owner and the admins manage this business's settings. You can still change your own account below.
readOnly: You can see these details. Only people who can edit the business can change them.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Your name, email, password and language.

lost.title: This business isn't open to you
lost.body: You're not a member of it any more, or it was removed. Ask its owner if you need access.

noAccess.title: This section isn't open to you
noAccess.body: Your role doesn't include it, or this business doesn't use it. Ask the owner if you need it.

business.title: Business profile
business.description: Your business name, logo and VAT details.

details.title: Business details
details.description: The name you use for your business, in English and in Arabic.

business.legalNameArHint: Optional. Used where BizCost shows your name in Arabic.
business.conflict: Someone else changed these details at the same time. Load the latest details, then make your change again.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Your logo, for your business in BizCost.
logo.rules: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
logo.removeBody: Your business will show without a logo. You can upload one again any time.
logo.wrongType: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
logo.tooBig: This image is larger than 2 MB. Choose a smaller one.

vat.title: VAT
vat.description: Turn this on if your business is registered for VAT in the UAE.
vat.registeredHint: You have a Tax Registration Number (TRN).
vat.trnHint: 15 digits, as on your VAT registration certificate.
vat.turningOn: When you save, the sections that use VAT, like VAT Center, are turned on.
vat.turningOff: When you save, the sections that need VAT, like VAT Center, are turned off. Nothing is deleted.
vat.trnMissing: Add your 15-digit TRN to finish your VAT details.

region.title: Country and currency
region.description: BizCost works in the UAE, in dirhams, for now.

locations.title: Branches
locations.description: The places where your business works.
locations.addDescription: Give it the name your team uses, for example the area or the mall.
locations.name: Branch name
locations.nameRequired: Enter a name for the branch.
locations.removeBody: It won't show in BizCost any more. Nothing recorded there is deleted.
locations.note: The main branch is where BizCost puts things when you don't choose a branch. To remove it, make another branch the main one first.

members.title: Team
members.description: The people who can sign in to this business.
members.changeRoleBody: Choose what {{name}} can see and do. The change applies right away.
members.removeBody: They lose access to {{businessName}} right away. What they recorded stays.
members.leaveBody: You lose access right away. To come back, you need a new invitation.
members.transferBody: {{name}} becomes the owner of {{businessName}} and can do everything, including changing the owner. You become an Admin. Only the new owner can give ownership back.
members.transferCodeSent: To keep the business safe, enter the code we sent to {{email}}.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: We'll email them a link to join. It works for 7 days.
invite.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
invite.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of this business.
invite.alreadyInvited: This email already has an invitation waiting. Send it again from the list instead.
invite.dailyLimit_one: You can send up to {{count}} invitation a day. Try again tomorrow.
invite.dailyLimit_other: You can send up to {{count}} invitations a day. Try again tomorrow.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Invitations sent and not accepted yet.
invitations.resent: Invitation sent again to {{email}}, with a new link.
invitations.noResendsLeft: This invitation was sent the most times allowed. Cancel it and invite again.
invitations.revokeBody: The link sent to {{email}} stops working.

roleInfo.owner: Can do everything, now and later, including changing the owner.
roleInfo.admin: Can do everything except change the owner.
roleInfo.manager: Sees the business, the team, costs, profit and supplier prices. Manages branches.
roleInfo.accountant: Sees the business, costs, profit, supplier prices and payroll.
roleInfo.supervisor: Sees the dashboard and the team.
roleInfo.employee: Sees the dashboard only. Never sees costs or profit.
roleInfo.custom: Customized for this business. It can {{list}}.
roleInfo.customNone: Customized for this business. It can't do anything yet.
roleInfo.notYours: Has access you don't have, so you can't give it.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What each role can see and do.
roles.note: Each person has one role. Changes apply right away to everyone with the role. Costs and profit stay hidden unless a role allows them.
roles.conflict: Someone else changed this role at the same time. Its latest permissions are shown; check them and save again.
roles.lockedNote: Some switches are locked: you can only give access you have yourself.
roles.lockedRole: This role has access you don't have, so you can't change it.
roles.ownRoleNote: This is your role: what you change applies to you too.
roles.ownRoleTitle: Take this access away from yourself?
roles.ownRoleBody: You'll lose: {{list}}. Only the owner, or someone who still has this access, can give it back.

permissionHints.settings_business_view: Name, logo, VAT details and language.
permissionHints.settings_business_edit: Change the name, logo, VAT details and language.
permissionHints.settings_members_view: Who is in the team, and invitations waiting.
permissionHints.settings_members_manage: Invite people, change their roles and remove them.
permissionHints.settings_roles_manage: Change what each role can see and do.
permissionHints.settings_modules_manage: Turn sections and features on or off.
permissionHints.data_cost_view: What products, materials and work really cost.
permissionHints.data_employee_pii_view: Phone numbers, IDs and other private details of employees.

modules.title: Customize BizCost
modules.description: Turn sections and features on or off as your business changes.
modules.hideNote: Turning something off only hides it. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn it on again any time.
modules.banner: BizCost opens in stages. What you turn on is saved, and each section appears by itself when it's ready.
modules.confirmBody: These sections need it, so they are turned off too. Nothing is deleted; you can turn them on again any time.
modules.teamInUse: To turn this off, first remove the other members and cancel the invitations in Team.
modules.locationsInUse: To turn this off, first remove the other branches in Branches.
modules.needsVat: Needs VAT registration. Turn on VAT in the business profile first.
modules.vatInProfile: VAT is set in the business profile, with your TRN.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of your business, and your own.

business.title: Business language
business.description: Invitations are sent in this language unless you choose another one.

yours.title: Your language
yours.description: The language you see BizCost in is part of your account.

leave.title: Leave this business
leave.description: You lose access to it. To come back, you need a new invitation.
